if: the revenue is a dividend, being a reward from the holding of investments in shares
then: the dividend is NOT recognised in the statement of profit and loss UNTIL A RIGHT TO RECEIVE PAYMENT IS ESTABLISHED
note: This is a prohibition with a single release condition, which is why it is stated negatively — AS 9 para 8.4 says the dividend is not recognised UNTIL the right is established. Time elapsed, profitability of the investee, and expectation of a declaration are all irrelevant. Para 13 additionally requires that no significant uncertainty as to measurability or collectability exists.
